how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: UNESCO: Serengeti ecosystem
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: UNESCO identifies the Serengeti-Mara as a connected migration ecosystem and discusses conservation pressure.

how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: UNESCO: Okavango Delta
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: The Okavango Delta is a landlocked wetland whose annual river flood arrives in Botswana's dry season.

how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: Kenya Wildlife Service: Amboseli park and rules
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: Amboseli encompasses grassland, swamps and acacia habitat; official KWS rules include staying in vehicles, using authorised roads and respecting wildlife.

how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: SANParks: Kruger visitor code
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: Kruger enforces vehicle, wildlife-disturbance, road and gate-time restrictions.

how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: SANParks: Kruger visitor tips
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: SANParks advises visitors to travel slowly and avoid covering too much ground.

how-to-choose-an-african-safari.title: CDC Yellow Book: safari health
how-to-choose-an-african-safari.fact: CDC recommends personal travel-health risk assessment and mosquito bite avoidance on African safaris.
